German lexical decision by L1 and L2 speakers

Source: R/data.R
lexical_decision_l2.Rd

30 participants (15 L1 and 15 L2 speakers of German) each respond to the same 40 German words. L2 speakers are slower and more sensitive to frequency.

Usage

lexical_decision_l2

Format

A tibble with 1200 rows and 6 columns:

participant

Participant ID, P01 to P30.

group

"L1" or "L2".

word

Word ID, w01 to w40.

log_freq

log10 word frequency, 1 to 6.

length

Length in letters, 3 to 13; frequent words are shorter.

rt

Reaction time in ms.

Source

data-raw/lexical_decision_l2.R

Details

True model: log(rt) = 6.55 + 0.16 * L2 + p0 + w0 + slope * (log_freq - 3.5) + 0.017 * (length - 7) + e, where slope = -0.035 - 0.03 * L2 + p1. By-participant intercepts p0 have SD 0.085 and slopes p1 SD 0.015; by-word intercepts w0 have SD 0.04; residual SD 0.09.

Examples

head(lexical_decision_l2)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   participant group word  log_freq length    rt
#>   <fct>       <fct> <fct>    <dbl>  <int> <dbl>
#> 1 P01         L1    w01       4.38      3   568
#> 2 P01         L1    w02       3.84      8   632
#> 3 P01         L1    w03       2.64      8   636
#> 4 P01         L1    w04       4.85      5   655
#> 5 P01         L1    w05       1.68     10   666
#> 6 P01         L1    w06       4.25      7   686
